_readme: Machine-readable storyboards. Human version and scripts: docs/storyboards.md. DRAFTS until the owner approves. model: 'kling' = Soul 9:16 still -> Kling 2.5 image-to-video (people); 'wan' = Wan 3.0 text-to-video (settings, objects). 'who' pulls a fixed cast description + seed so one character stays one person.

modern.look: a man in his early thirties with short dark hair and a grey t-shirt, in a plain modern apartment

marcus.look: Marcus Aurelius, a Roman emperor in his fifties with a curly greying beard, plain wool tunic and cloak

shots.picture: sitting on the edge of his bed in a dark bedroom at dawn, phone alarm glowing on the nightstand beside him, not reaching for it, wide shot from the doorway
shots.motion: he stays completely still, only breathing, the phone screen pulses

shots.picture: sitting on the edge of a camp cot inside a leather army tent before dawn, same pose, one small oil lamp on a stool beside him, wide shot from the tent entrance
shots.motion: he stays completely still, only breathing, the lamp flame flickers

shots.picture: extreme close-up of an old man's hand pressing a bronze stylus into a wax tablet by oil lamp light
inside a Roman army tent, the entrance flap stirring in the wind, beyond it rows of tents in blue pre-dawn light and smoke rising from a campfire
in profile inside the lamp-lit tent, eyes closed, calm, close-up
shots.motion: his lips move silently as if rehearsing words, very slow push in

shots.picture: standing at a bathroom mirror in soft morning light, still, eyes steady, medium shot
shots.motion: his lips move silently as if naming people, he stays calm

shots.picture: lift doors sliding open onto a bright modern office in the morning, a man in a shirt steps out and nods to a colleague
sitting on the edge of his bed at night, warm bedside lamp on, shoulders relaxed, wide shot from the doorway
shots.motion: he exhales slowly and lies back onto the bed
